# Harshal Dorlikar

> Founder, Builder, and Creator of Kosmo.

## Identity
Harshal Dorlikar is a product builder based in India. He focuses entirely on building 100% with AI, shipping production-ready software and agentic systems at immense speed. 

## Philosophy
"Building 100% with AI since November 30, 2022."
He operates with a "reality over adjectives" approach, heavily inspired by Paul Graham's style of straightforward, high-signal communication.

## Core Projects

### Kosmo
Kosmo (https://askkosmo.com) is an AI Prompt Compiler that turns plain English ideas into structured, tool-aware AI prompts grounded in live documentation. It automatically injects expert guardrails, strict boundaries, and hidden reasoning loops (like the Socratic Loop and Anti-Cliché constraints).
- Recognition: Winner of the Education and Human Potential category prize ($50,000) in the global Build with Gemini XPRIZE competition (September 2026), selected from over 26,000 registered builders worldwide.

### A-41 Housing
A-41 Housing (https://a41housing.com) is a high-converting premium real estate web app built to market and lease a premium 3BHK student housing property directly to high-value tenants.

### GOAT (Autonomous Sports Betting AI)
A 100% autonomous AI agent designed to execute real-time sports betting strategies.

### EdAI
An AI platform that turns static textbooks into interactive, game-like micro-courses to force active recall and engagement.
